scope: Simple pair bench inside the full game with a loaded save (original with the function hook off vs candidate with the hook on), 7808 isolated CPU pairs for 9 pending functions of CWeapon, ALL pairs equal, pair counts equal to the bank table, passed=true globally, natural "complete" event with state_restored, saves unchanged, configs restored. Each case rebuilds the same deterministic fixture (seed = case index) in both legs and compares the return value, the bytes of the fake objects, the touched global ranges, the x87 control word (24 bits) and the whole trace of doubled collaborators with raw arguments; foreign threads ignored. Traced doubles get NO credit. Only the own part of each function is validated. Source tested == current working tree at registration (class sources match the probe build manifest). Historical evidence approved with explicit limits; no current dependency accreditation. Fixtures: fake entities/peds/vehicles/objects, fake reference list and temporary swaps of ped/object pools, cameras, time and players, always restored; padding and uninitialised bytes masked. Limits are declared per function in the function-specific scope and in the bank README. Revalidado el 2026-10-26 tras reconstruir colaboradores (lote 67 y anteriores); el banco se adapto a ellos (ver su README.md).
